name: web-feature-comparison-table-free-pro-enterprise-with-green-ticks
title: Plan comparison table with hairline rows, green ticks, grey dashes and values like 'Up to 3' and '1 TB'
whatItIs: A white table with columns Feature, Free, Pro and Enterprise and ten rows (Projects, Team members, Storage, Custom domains, Advanced analytics, API access, Priority support, SSO & SAML, Audit logs, Dedicated manager) marked by green ticks, grey dashes or plain values such as Up to 3, 5 GB and Unlimited, divided by hairlines.
whatItMeans: Clear and dependable; green ticks and grey dashes make availability instantly visible.
techniques: Use green ticks for included and grey dashes for excluded.

vocabulary.definition: A table comparing features across plans.
A column representing one pricing tier.
